hintroom.level8.armurerie: Center lever, then each hero pulls theirs in the window. Defeat the garrison.
hintroom.level8.cabinet: Two twin statues to turn, then a plate guarded by archers.
hintroom.level8.chicane: The red hero reads the runes, the others strike them. Then an hourglass guards the way.
hintroom.level8.conseil: The forge lord has every plan. Stay together, hit hard, grab the bonuses first.
hintroom.level8.fosses: Pits: a plate, a rampart to hold 18 s (green hero), then the four levers together.
hintroom.level8.parvis: Four colored plates: each hero holds theirs, together. The chief has a plan!
hintroom.level8.veilleurs: He watches over fallen heroes: hit him to dislodge him, then revive your ally.
hintroom.level8.vigie: Four plans: vigil, crystal, calls, bonuses. Stay together and hit hard!
level.level8.intro.1: Beyond the Void stands a bastion. Its banners no longer bear any crest.
level.level8.intro.2: They do not charge at you. They wait for one of you to fall.
level.level8.intro.3: Morvane has studied each of your fights.
level.level8.intro.4: Then we do not fall alone.
level.level8.name: The Strategists' Bastion
level.level8.outro.1: The fragment pulses toward the tallest belfry in the kingdom.
level.level8.outro.2: One bell remains to be rung. The last one.
objective.level8.arsenal: Red hero: 5 finishing blows in the armory
objective.level8.banner: Blue hero: open the courtyard door
objective.level8.plans: Yellow hero: align the Cabinet statues
objective.level8.rampart: Green hero: hold the rampart for 18 s

room.level8.cabinet.name: Plan Cabinet
room.level8.chicane.name: Rune Chicane
room.level8.conseil.name: War Council
room.level8.fosses.name: Siege Pits

sign.level8.armurerie.arsenal: Red hero: five finishing blows in the armory. Clearing the room counts too.
sign.level8.armurerie.base: Center lever: pull it once. It stays engaged.
sign.level8.armurerie.door: The door needs the center lever and the four colored levers.
sign.level8.armurerie.levers: One lever per color in the corners: it falls back fast, pull them almost together.
sign.level8.cabinet.door: This door opens when both statues face north.
sign.level8.cabinet.plate: Archers guard the plate. It opens the exit gate for good.
sign.level8.cabinet.sockets: On a socket, Action turns the other statue a quarter turn. Yellow hero, your turn!
sign.level8.cabinet.statues: Two twin statues face the wrong way: both must face north.
sign.level8.chicane.hourglass: Hourglass portcullis: the far lever reopens it, but the sand does not last.
sign.level8.chicane.relay: Relay: one flips the far lever, the others cross, then the near lever reopens it.
sign.level8.chicane.runes: The pedestals are here, the rune screen is far to the north-east. Call out the order!
sign.level8.chicane.screen: Rune screen: only the red hero sees the sequence. He dictates it to the others.
sign.level8.conseil.counter: Stay together, hit hard, use your special. Grab bonuses before he does.
sign.level8.conseil.plans: The forge lord has every plan: vigil, crystal, calls, carrier, bonus, weakest.
sign.level8.fosses.levers: Four colored levers in the rampart corners: pull them almost together.
sign.level8.fosses.pits: Pits cut the room: only two narrow passages cross them.
sign.level8.fosses.plate: The plate opens the postern. Once open, it stays open.
sign.level8.fosses.rampart: Rampart: the ambush springs here. The green hero must hold the zone for 18 seconds.
sign.level8.parvis.door: This door only opens when all four plates are held together.
sign.level8.parvis.eye: An icon above a chief shows his plan; its legend is under his health bar.
sign.level8.parvis.plates: Each hero holds the plate of their color, all at once: the door opens.
sign.level8.veilleurs.counter: Against his vigil: hit hard or use a special, he drops his plan. Stay together.
sign.level8.veilleurs.crystals: Healing crystals in the arena (the last from 3 heroes): stand on one, then press B.
sign.level8.veilleurs.eye: The guardian has a plan: when a hero falls, he watches over them. An icon shows it.
sign.level8.vigie.bonus: He sits on bonuses on the ground and seizes half-hearts: grab them before he does.
sign.level8.vigie.counter: An isolated call draws him: stay together. Hit hard or use a special to dislodge him.
sign.level8.vigie.plans: Four plans: watch an ally, guard a crystal, follow a call, sit on a bonus.
